title: Anhui Satellite TV Broadcasts the First AI-Produced Intangible Cultural Heritage Drama in China, 'The Story of Taohua River' AIGC Series Launches on Star-Rated Platforms

content_html:
Anhui Satellite TV recently aired the country's first mid-length TV drama, "The Legend of Tao Hua Tan," which was fully produced using AI technology and focuses on intangible cultural heritage. The drama officially launched on a satellite channel, airing every night at 9:50 PM. A special note at the end of the episode reads "AIGC Director," marking the entry of AI-generated content into the traditional television broadcasting system.

"The Legend of Tao Hua Tan" is set against the backdrop of the traditional paper-making techniques of Xuan paper in Jing County, Anhui. It combines intangible cultural heritage with elements of Ming Dynasty political intrigue and suspense, telling a story centered around the craftsmanship of Xuan paper. The drama adopts a lightweight mid-length format, consisting of 20 episodes, each about 10 minutes long, and has obtained a network TV series distribution license, achieving a transition from online content platforms to satellite TV screens.

In recent years, with the rapid development of generative AI technology, AI film and television production has gradually become an industry exploration direction. In addition to Anhui Satellite TV, Zhejiang Satellite TV, Guangdong Satellite TV, and Oriental Satellite TV have also begun to enter the AI drama market, trying different themes such as mythology, science fiction, and history, promoting the diversified development of AI content production models.

However, AI dramas still face dual challenges from technology and the market. Currently, some AI-generated content suffers from unnatural facial expressions, lack of action coherence, and limited video stability, sparking discussions about content quality. Supporters argue that AI can significantly reduce the cost of film and television production and improve creative efficiency, with some projects' production cycles being shortened from months to days. In the future, AI is expected to become an important tool for the industrialized production of films and television.

The broadcast of "The Legend of Tao Hua Tan" signifies that AI dramas are moving from experimental stages on short video platforms toward a more standardized film and television distribution system. With continuous improvements in model capabilities, the way AI integrates with human creation will become an important direction for competition in the film and television industry.

content_html_zh:
安徽卫视近日播出了全国首部全人工智能技术制作、聚焦非物质文化遗产的中长剧《桃花潭传奇》。 该剧正式在卫星频道开播，每晚9点50分播出。 剧集结尾处特别注明“AIGC导演”，标志着人工智能生成的内容进入传统电视广播系统。

《桃花潭传奇》以安徽泾县宣纸传统造纸技艺为背景。 该剧将非物质文化遗产与明代政治阴谋、悬疑元素相结合，讲述了一个围绕宣纸工艺展开的故事。 该剧采用轻量级中长格式，共20集，每集时长约10分钟，并已获得网络电视剧发行许可，实现了从网络内容平台到卫视荧屏的转变。

近年来，随着生成式AI技术的快速发展，AI影视制作逐渐成为行业探索方向。 除安徽卫视外，浙江卫视、广东卫视、东方卫视也开始进军AI剧市场，尝试神话、科幻、历史等不同题材，推动AI内容制作模式多元化发展。

但AI剧仍面临技术和市场的双重挑战。 目前，一些人工智能生成的内容存在面部表情不自然、动作缺乏连贯性、视频稳定性有限等问题，引发了关于内容质量的讨论。 支持者认为，人工智能可以显着降低影视制作成本，提高创作效率，一些项目的制作周期从几个月缩短到几天。 未来，人工智能有望成为影视工业化制作的重要工具。

《桃花潭传奇》的播出，标志着人工智能剧正从短视频平台的实验阶段走向更加规范的影视发行体系。 随着模型能力的不断提升，AI与人类创作的融合方式将成为影视行业竞争的重要方向。
